biotools.summary: ClarID is a domain-agnostic specification for human-readable, metadata-rich identifiers for subjects and biospecimens. ClarID-Tools is an open-source command-line utility for generating, decoding, and validating these identifiers.
biotools.name: ClarID-Tools: Biomedical Metadata Identifier Specification and Implementation
